title: Relay restart
note: 10 relay restarts (railway restart, 75 s apart) with the phone forced onto the relay path: 10/10 recovered, phone loss-to-usable-gateway p50 1428 / p95 1804 / max 1804 ms; the helper re-admitted itself each time without a gateway restart. Recovery measured from the phone's content-free stage trace (first connecting after the loss to the next applied ready).
